Donald Trump has given Chinese President Xi Jinping a rare red-carpet welcome at the White House, but behind the ceremony lies a deeply complicated US-China relationship.
From Taiwan and trade to AI, critical minerals and the Iran war, Trump and Xi face a long list of contentious issues. With Washington extending the existing trade truce, can the two leaders prevent another escalation?
Watch LIVE as Hem Kaur Saroya explains key takeaways from the Trump-Xi summit.
